html:
Spine Surgery and Treatment at Silver Touch Hospitals

Back pain can begin innocently enough, but gradually it can become a hindrance to daily activities. Whether a slipped disc, nerve compression, or chronic spine disorder, the way to effective treatment is through a proper diagnosis.

At Silver Touch Hospitals, our spine experts are dedicated to alleviating pain, regaining mobility, and helping you resume your normal routine safely. We treat both surgical and non-surgical conditions of the spine, providing customised care according to your individual condition.

We are your go-to spine specialist in Ahmedabad if you are seeking reliable and experienced consultations, state-of-the-art diagnostics, and cutting-edge treatment modalities all under one roof.

Conditions We Treat

Our multidisciplinary team manages a variety of spinal disorders, including:

  • Disc herniation and sciatica
  • Spinal stenosis
  • Spondylosis and arthritis-related spine pain
  • Spinal fractures
  • Degenerative spine conditions
  • Spine injuries due to an accident or a fall

Treatments may involve physiotherapy, pain management, or surgery, depending on the severity. Our objective is always to attempt conservative interventions first and move on to surgery only if required.

Advanced Surgical Solutions

When surgery is unavoidable, we employ minimally invasive and image-guided methodologies to support faster recovery and reduced risks of complications. Whatever your need – spinal decompression, stabilization, or corrective surgery – we develop a treatment plan according to your lifestyle and medical requirements.

If you require a spine specialist doctor in Ahmedabad, Silver Touch Hospitals merges expertise, experience, and compassion in a single location.

For those looking for a spine specialist doctor in Prahladnagar, our Satellite center is well placed and provides spine care with the support of in-house diagnosis and rehabilitation services.

faqs.q: Do all spine problems need surgery?
faqs.a: Absolutely not. Many of them can be treated with physiotherapy, medicines, and posture correction. Surgery is undertaken only when non-surgical management doesn’t benefit and treating doctor feeling the need for it.

faqs.q: How long does it take to recover from spine surgery?
faqs.a: Recovery is dependent upon the procedure and general health. Some are ambulatory in a matter of days, while others require several weeks of supervised rehab.
There is some risk with any surgery, but techniques today and skilled surgeons minimize complications.
